success.title: Thank you!
success.message: We'll be in touch within 24 business hours. In the meantime you can reach us at hello@bambooit.pl.

1.q: Does the contract lock me in for years?
1.a: No. The contract is monthly with a one-month notice period. We believe that if we do good work, we don't need a contract to keep you.

2.q: What if I already have an in-house IT person?
2.a: Great. We can act as second-line support — when your IT is on vacation, overwhelmed with tickets, or lacks specialist expertise (GDPR, audits, migrations).

3.q: Do you only work in Wrocław?
3.a: Remote support across all of Poland. On-site visits — Wrocław and the surrounding area (up to 50 km). For greater distances — quoted individually.

4.a: All day-to-day matters — computer, printer, email, M365, VPN, access, password issues. Larger projects (migrations, deployments, hardware purchases) are quoted upfront separately.

5.q: How do you handle hardware you procure for us?
5.a: We don't take vendor commissions — that's a rule. You buy the hardware under your company name, we advise and configure.

6.a: We sign a data processing agreement (GDPR), all staff signed NDAs, connections are encrypted, access is logged. Quarterly internal audit.

finalCta.heading: Time to hand IT over to good hands.

header.heading: Three packages. Clear cost.
header.lede: Fixed monthly fee, clear scope, monthly notice. Pick a package or start with a free audit — we'll show which package actually fits.

1.q: What if I exceed package hours?
1.a: Each extra hour is billed at the package rate (90 PLN/h on Start, 80 PLN/h on Firma, 70 PLN/h on Firma Plus). We notify you before you cross the limit and propose an upgrade if it keeps happening.

2.a: Yes, anytime — up or down. The change takes effect the next billing period. No penalties, no negotiation.

3.a: Yes — the first month is fully paid, but if it doesn't fit, cancel within 30 days and we refund 100%. No explanations, no questions.

4.a: Larger projects (server migrations, new system rollouts, hardware purchases) are quoted upfront separately. Same for group training and one-off security audits. Everything with transparent pricing before we start.
